_comment: Undyed synthetic stretch knit (Phase08 8.4, RD-P08-5): a polyester-elastane single jersey, the stuff of leggings, sportswear and a fitted top. Authored white so a Creator's tint (a 0-1 multiply) reaches every dyed colour. OPAQUE with a soft sheen and very little FUZZ: continuous filament, unlike Cotton_Jersey's staple cotton. The knit (Cotton_Jersey's loop, 20 wales x 28 courses per cm) is the article's own normal and roughness.
name: StretchKnit_Natural_Clean_Base_s001_v01

sources.why: Colour: undyed polyester, a near-neutral white (linear 0.80, 0.80, 0.79; no measured value). IOR 1.57: polyester, the bulk of the blend (elastane is a few per cent). Roughness ~0.55 in the map: the soft sheen of a filament knit (Cotton_Jersey is ~0.82). Fuzz 0.15: filament sheds little.
